news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax completed a successful pre-NDA meeting with the FDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, with the agency providing constructive feedback on the submission strategy. The company reaffirmed it remains on track to submit its first NDA by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Abivax price target raised to $180 from $132 at Morgan Stanley
news.summary: Morgan Stanley raised its 12-month price target on Abivax to $180 from $132 while maintaining an Overweight rating, citing continued confidence following the ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 data. The upgrade added to a wave of analyst price-target increases across multiple firms.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders spanning marketing, patient services, sales and market access to build out its U.S. go-to-market team ahead of a planned NDA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis in Q4 2026. The hires signal the company is preparing to commercialize independently rather than solely relying on a partner.

news.headline: Abivax re-engages Centerview amid renewed takeover interest
news.summary: French outlet La Lettre reported Abivax has re-engaged bank Centerview as takeover speculation resurfaced, with some analysts modeling a deal as large as $23 billion. No formal offer or process has been confirmed by the company.

news.headline: Abivax $920 million cash haul lets it prepare for solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer, CEO tells CNBC
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel told CNBC the freshly raised $920 million gives Abivax the option to launch obefazimod in the U.S. on its own rather than needing a Big Pharma partner or acquirer. The comments came amid persistent takeover speculation around the company.

news.headline: Abivax Reports Positive ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Results for Obefazimod in Refractory Ulcerative Colitis Patients
news.summary: Supplemental Phase 3 data showed obefazimod produced meaningful clinical and endoscopic remission (37.2% of prior non-responders reached remission) in a highly refractory UC population, and that dose escalation to 50mg could recapture remission after relapse. Safety data, including malignancy rates, remained consistent with expected UC background rates, reinforcing the drug's benefit-risk profile after a cancer-signal scare had hit the stock earlier in the quarter.

catalysts.label: US FDA NDA submission for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Following a positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA on July 30, Abivax remains on track to file its New Drug Application in Q4 2026, based on the completed ABTECT Phase 3 induction and maintenance dataset.

catalysts.label: EMA MAA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for a Marketing Authorization Application submission to the European Medicines Agency in the second half of 2026, contingent on the positive maintenance data already reported.

catalysts.label: Crohn's disease Phase 2b (ENHANCE-CD) induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the 12-week induction portion of the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial in moderate-to-severely active Crohn's disease are expected, which will inform design of subsequent registrational studies.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA review/approval decision for obefazimod in UC
catalysts.detail: Following the planned Q4 2026 NDA filing and FDA acceptance, a standard review clock would put a potential approval decision (PDUFA date) sometime in 2027; exact date not yet set.

catalysts.label: M&A and partnership speculation
catalysts.detail: Persistent market speculation about a large pharma acquiring or partnering with Abivax continues (Centerview re-engaged mid-July per La Lettre, with some deal models cited as high as $23 billion), even as the CEO signals the company can go it alone in the US following its $920M raise.

catalysts.label: Build-out toward potential US commercial launch
catalysts.detail: With ~$920M raised and cash runway into 2029, Abivax is actively hiring commercial leadership and preparing launch infrastructure ahead of a possible US launch of obefazimod in ulcerative colitis following FDA approval.

pulse: Abivax closed out July with a positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA (announced July 30), reinforcing that its Q4 2026 NDA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis remains on track after a pivotal six weeks: fresh ABTECT maintenance data resolved most earlier malignancy concerns, funding a heavily oversubscribed $920M Nasdaq ADS offering, and the company is now building a US commercial organization (four new leadership hires in July) to launch independently rather than be forced into a takeover. Persistent M&A speculation continues (Centerview re-engaged mid-July, deal models cited up to $23 billion) alongside progress on the earlier-stage Crohn's disease program (ENHANCE-CD), with induction data due late 2026.
